name: GDPR / privacy pass
description: Privacy baseline: privacy policy page present, comment settings conservative, user inventory, and a moderation sweep of pending items.

steps.title: Inventory the site
steps.detail: Call wp_get_site_info and wp_list_posts (post_type=page) to find the privacy policy page. Note if it is missing or a stub.

steps.title: Comment policy
steps.detail: Call wp_get_settings and report comment_moderation and comment_registration status. Call wp_update_settings to enable manual moderation ONLY with explicit owner confirmation.

steps.title: Users inventory
steps.detail: Call wp_list_users (per_page=100) and list roles; flag stale accounts (no posts) for the owner without deleting anything.

steps.title: Moderation sweep
steps.detail: Call wp_list_comments (status=hold) and summarize volume and obvious spam; with confirmation, call wp_moderate_comment to mark spam as spam (never delete).

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver: privacy page status, comment settings (changed or not, with confirmation), user inventory highlights, spam counts.

guardrails: Never delete users or comments in this playbook: privacy work must be reversible.
wp_update_settings changes are owner-confirmed one by one.
